description: Generic agentic conversation template. Documents are delivered via simulated search_files/read_file tool-call cycles.

messages.content:
<think>
The user wants me to help with this task. Let me first search for relevant project documents to find the information I need.
</think>
<tool_call>
{"name": "search_files", "arguments": {"pattern": "*.*", "target": "files", "path": "docs", "limit": 20}}
</tool_call>

<think>
I found some relevant documents. Let me read them to gather the information needed for the user's request.
</think>
<tool_call>
{"name": "read_file", "arguments": {"path": "docs/docA.txt"}}
</tool_call>

<think>
I've read the first document. Let me now read the second one to get more context.
</think>
<tool_call>
{"name": "read_file", "arguments": {"path": "docs/docB.txt"}}
</tool_call>

<think>
Let me also check the third document for additional context.
</think>
<tool_call>
{"name": "read_file", "arguments": {"path": "docs/docC.txt"}}
</tool_call>
